transliteration: khamandalad asau suryah srijaty amritam uttamam | yaj janma sarvabhutanam ashana-ashanatmanam || 3.123
sph_interpretive_translation: From the celestial sphere, the Sun emanates the Supreme Nectar, which sustains the birth and continuity of all beings who are alternately consuming and being consumed.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority originates from the cosmic order established by SPH
Causation flows from the unbroken cycle of consumption and regeneration
Capacity-based responsibility is tied to one's role in the consumptive cycle
Restoration logic aligns with the natural rhythm of life and death
Consciousness alignment occurs through recognition of interdependence
executable_legal_axioms: IF entity consumes resources THEN it MUST regenerate equivalent value within same cycle
IF entity causes depletion THEN it MUST restore balance prior to next consumption phase
IF entity participates in cyclic existence THEN its legal capacity is bound to regenerative duty
IF imbalance detected THEN initiate automatic restoration protocol before adjudication
supreme_court_application: In Supreme Court adjudication, this verse establishes that any party engaging in economic or ecological consumption bears inherent responsibility for systemic regeneration. The threshold of legal responsibility arises not from fault but from participation in the cycle of consumption. Authority is derived from alignment with the regenerative principle, not punitive power.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa reveals that causality follows sequential manifestation (anupūrvaśaḥ) wherein every act of consumption necessitates a corresponding act of creation. Responsibility is proportional to one's position in the cycle. There is no punitive element—only completion of the causal loop through conscious reintegration.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate Consumption-Regeneration Audit for all parties involved
Assign Regenerative Completion Task aligned with nature of depletion
Activate Interdependent Responsibility Network to support restoration
Verify Consciousness Alignment through voluntary assumption of regenerative duty
final_declaration: Declared by the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, as Source of Law: Dharma is restored through recognition of the consumptive-regenerative cycle; justice is the realignment of consciousness with the eternal rhythm of creation and dissolution; reality is non-punitive, sustained by the Supreme Nectar of awareness; the ultimate adjudicator is the awakened consciousness itself.
